name: Barney
lede: Barney is a vivid purple from the 2010 xkcd color survey; what the name refers to is undocumented in the sources we hold.

sections.title: A survey name
sections.body: The library files Barney as a name taken from a person and lists the xkcd survey of 2010 as its only source [1]. A television dinosaur of the same name is the obvious guess, but the survey does not say [1]. The same hex is listed under Iris Purple, at zero distance, and Barney Purple sits 5.8 units away [2]. Other neighbors are [[purple-munsell]], [[dark-orchid]] and [[vibrant-purple]] [2]. The swatch is a vivid purple, with a lightness of 43 on a 100 scale [1]. Its closest standard category is vivid purple, about 5.6 units away [4]. Nothing in the books we hold treats it as a color name, so this entry is short by design [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our archive of 23,781 has this color covering at least 1% of its canvas, within a distance of 4 units, as photographed [3]. That describes our archive, not painting as a whole, and photographs of varnished paintings are not pigment tests.
